articles.title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
articles.snippet: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

articles.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
articles.snippet: The majority leader opened the multi-stage process the Senate follows when trying to get a bill over its 60-vote hurdle, so it's still got a shot in September.

articles.title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
articles.snippet: After months of public warnings from onchain analysts, the prediction market is moving to time-weighted prices to make artificial price pushes too costly.

articles.title: US Treasury’s OFAC sanctions 2 Iran-linked crypto exchanges
articles.snippet: The US government sanctioned an individual and two crypto exchanges it said facilitated money laundering for a combined $5 million in digital assets linked to Iran.

articles.title: Bitcoin price tags $65.3K August high as low US jobs numbers cool Fed rate bets
articles.snippet: Bitcoin hit month-to-date highs above $65,000 as risk-assets gained on low US nonfarm payrolls data.
